messages:
Chetana - Partnerships: Heads up — need to align the SI sandbox curriculum, HW partner demo rigs, and marketplace listing timing. Can we lock a Day 0 plan this week? TL;DR: labs + cert + marketplace publish should be coordinated.

Marie (SI Ops): Yes — propose Wed 5/14 for the Day 0 run-through. Lab access, smoke tests, and SE shadowing in the AM, cert window in the PM.

Sam K. (SE): Wed works for me. Can we get hardware inventory by EOD Monday? @Alex B. can you confirm partner booth/demo rack availability + SKU images?

Alex B. (Marketplace): I can grab SKU images and sample configs. HW partner (NebulaGrid) confirmed demo racks available week of 5/13. I'll upload to the shared drive: https://redwood.app/drive/si-sandbox — will add to the checklist.

marketplace-bot: Listing draft for 'SI Sandbox — NebulaGrid' created: https://marketplace.redwood/listings/draft-9876

Marie (SI Ops): For certs — two tracks: Basic = walkthrough + lab sign-off; Pro = hands-on lab + 1 live customer-facing scenario. Need clear publishable criteria in the playbook.

Chetana - Partnerships: Agree. Quick schedule snippet (for the playbook):

```
Wed 5/14 09:00 Kickoff (all)
Wed 5/14 10:30 HW smoke + image upload
Wed 5/14 13:00 SE shadow labs
Thu 5/15 09:00 Cert exam window opens
```

Sam K. (SE): Can we run a dry run with one SI on Tue 5/13? Also need an intake form (name/company/desired track/hw needs). I can spin up a Typeform.

Marie (SI Ops): Please include 'network/VLAN access' and 'data retention opt-out' as required fields on the intake.

Alex B. (Marketplace): I'll add SKU images and short config snippets to the listing. Filenames I will upload: nebula_demo_v1.jpg, nebula_cfg_4g.json.

Chetana - Partnerships: Action items: Alex uploads images by Mon EOD; Sam creates intake + schedules dry-run; Marie drafts cert criteria; I'll update the sandbox playbook and ping Legal for joint announcement copy. :thumbsup:

Sam K. (SE): I'll post the intake link in #partners and tag a small SI cohort. ETA Tues noon.

Marie (SI Ops): I'll circulate the cert matrix by Tue EOD.

marketplace-bot: Announcement checklist created: draft -> review -> publish.
